name: geulbang
description: 쌤유 글방: 초등 수업용 실시간 글쓰기 웹앱

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p tests/integration && tsc -p tests/e2e
scripts.check: prettier --check . && npm run typecheck && npm run check:rules && npm run test:checks
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test -- --maxWorkers=1 && npm run build && npm run e2e -- --workers=1
scripts.check:rules: node tools/checks/layers.mjs && node tools/checks/forbidden.mjs && node tools/checks/free-plan.mjs && node tools/checks/prd-sync.mjs && node tools/checks/bundle.mjs && node apps/web/scripts/gen-icons.mjs --check
